jupas.shortDescription: an class="before_label">Short Description This programme aims to provide graduates with an integrated and holistic training in biomedical sciences. Adopting a multi-disciplinary approach and coupling theories with practical and hands-on training, the programme will produce solidly trained graduates for diversified career paths in scientific research, health system policy and management, or clinical, pharmaceutical, diagnostics and healthcare related professions, as well as leaders with global perspective. Upon completion of the Programme, graduates will have: had a strong, broad-based foundation and advanced specialised knowledge in selected areas of biomedical sciences and research; developed a broad range of skills and values, including a capacity for lifelong learning and conducting biomedical research; acquired skills to apply critical and creative thinking to analyse problems, to identify ethical dilemmas relating to biomedical sciences and research, and to offer feasible solutions; demonstrated good understanding of the policy issues and strategic management pertaining to public health, pharmaceutical industry, diseases and medicine; been equipped with practical and hands-on training and exposure to real-life scenarios through experiences in a biomedical research laboratory or within an industrial setting; developed effective interpersonal and communication skills.

cuhkAdmission.introduction: Make a Positive Impact on Society by Starting Your Biomedical Sciences Voyage The BSc in Biomedical Sciences is a multi-disciplinary, comprehensive and integrative Programme that best illustrates the relevance of biomedical sciences in the clinical, pharmaceutical and healthcare settings. The curriculum closely follows modern medical trends, including innovative treatments for, and diagnosis of, diseases and new solutions to address global health demands. Our courses are delivered by leading scientists in the School of Biomedical Sciences, guest speakers from the Clinical Departments of the Faculty of Medicine, and industry experts who share their views on how biomedical advances impact modern medicine.

cuhkAdmission.careerProspects: The Biomedical Sciences programme equips students with solid knowledge of biomedical sciences and exposes them to innovations and developments in the industry. It is our mission to ensure that our students are well prepared to enter to the ever-evolving biomedical industry. Graduate Studies Our graduates also have a strong track record in securing master’s and doctoral degrees in biomedical sciences with a specialised area of interest at CUHK and other renowned universities, including the University of Oxford, Imperial College London, University College London and King’s College. Career Options There is strong demand for biomedical graduates in the thriving biomedical sciences and healthcare-related industries. Our graduates are very well received by our industry partners, including pharmaceutical, diagnostic and biomedical companies, many of which are located in Hong Kong Science and Technology Park or related industry clusters. Industry, Medical Media Patent attorneys, scientists in biotechnology/biopharmaceutical companies, bioinformaticians, medical writers and media communication specialists. Health Services, Policy and Management Administrators in the government and hospital sectors, quality management personnel for advanced therapy products, and medical genetics or molecular genetics lab professionals. If you are interested in this programme, please review the application requirements and deadlines specific to the respective admission scheme to increase your chances of getting accepted. APPLY NOW
cuhkAdmission.craftYourPath: Solid and Practical Training Our curriculum emphasizes practicality and experiential learning. In addition to exposing students to exciting scientific advances, we guide students to explore the bioethical implications of emerging technologies and research in medicine. Courses are co-taught by experts in the field and clinical departments from the Faculty of Medicine, equipping students with a strong foundation in knowledge and principles of biomedical science, while demonstrating its relevance to clinical applications. Personalized Learning Experiences We emphasize student-centred, personalized learning experiences. The Major Electives are arranged in three unique Concentration Areas, supplemented by relevant Experiential Learning activities. This unique range of courses is the first of its kind to be included in a biomedical science‐based undergraduate programme in Hong Kong, offering a range of options for students who are interested in research, health policy, pharmaceutical manufacturing management and healthcare services.
